messages:
Maya R.: noticed the strict fncall validator canary (v1.0) flagged 3.7% validation_failed and routed those to fallback_small. customers reported doubled token counts.
Theo K.: do we have a minimal failing example?
Maya R.: from logs: `tool_response: \"{\\\"result\\\": \"[]\"}\"` -> expected object but got string.
Rita S.: product: no hidden retries. billing: we cant silently zero token counts without a contract.
Theo K.: propose header contract: `X-Validation-Outcome` = [ok, soft-warning, hard-fail, routed]. billing will zero retries if header==soft-warning and origin==validator.
Maya R.: add telemetry: metric `validation.v1.reject_rate` + dimension `reason=[type_mismatch, missing_field, malformed_json]`. traces include `validation.strict=true`.
Rita S.: console UX: badge "Schema warning" on invocation and link to sampled raw payload (scrubbed). admin toggle "Treat validation failures as warnings".
Theo K.: rollout: 1) metrics only, 2) badge + sampling, 3) soft-warning on 1% traffic, 4) 10% after 48h, 5) enable billing rule after sync.
Maya R.: sampling plan: canary=100% capture, prod=1% per-reason, hashed user_id, pii scrub.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for validator v1.0 on eng-platform (slice: beta). :rocket:
Maya R.: alert: pause if validation.v1.reject_rate > 3%.
deploy-bot: Canary paused automatically (validation.v1.reject_rate = 4.2%). reference: alert#val-901.
Theo K.: rolling back and opening RFC for header + sampling schema.
Rita S.: loop in billing + support. adding owners: Maya (validator), Theo (telemetry), Billing team.
Maya R.: will send invites and follow-ups. thanks everyone :heart:
